title: Juicy Pickled Saudia Tomato Salad
description: This rich and juicy Saudi Arabian dish features pickles alongside a tomato salad enhanced with sous-vide for a brunch-mood meal that's both halal-friendly and easy to prepare.
instructions: Sous-vide the eggs at 60°C for 30 minutes. Let them cool and peel off the shells.
Chop the red onion, dice the green bell pepper, and remove the seeds from the tomatoes.
In a large bowl, mix the chopped onions, halved tomatoes with seeds removed, diced bell peppers, and pickled jalapeños.
Add the leached juice of 1 lemon to the salad mixture. Season with salt to taste.
Peel and thinly slice the eggs. Mix them into the prepared salad.
Serve chilled or at room temperature as a side dish for breakfast.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
